name: enable_input_suppression

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_EnableInputSuppression takes no Script context, sets D_002B9660 to one, and does not access the value stack

notes: When D_002B9660 is nonzero in the relevant world state, func_00114480 calls func_00113660 to clear the synthesized controller button, press, and action masks.
